title: Payment Terms and Collection Thresholds — Microsoft 365 Cloud Subscriptions (CSP)
content:
Accounts receivable applies the payment terms below to Microsoft 365 Cloud Subscriptions (CSP) invoices. They cover net terms, the late fee, the suspension threshold and the card payment limit for each plan.

| Plan | Net terms from the invoice posted date | Monthly late fee | Grace period after the due date | Minimum late fee per invoice per month | Suspension threshold (days past due of the oldest unpaid invoice) | Commitment charged while suspended | Largest invoice payable by card |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Microsoft 365 Business Basic | 30 days | 1.5 percent | 10 days | 25.00 USD | 45 days | yes | 5000.00 USD |
| Microsoft 365 F3 | 30 days | 1.5 percent | 10 days | 25.00 USD | 45 days | yes | 5000.00 USD |
| Microsoft 365 Business Standard | 30 days | 1.5 percent | 10 days | 25.00 USD | 45 days | yes | 5000.00 USD |
| Microsoft 365 Business Premium | 30 days | 1.5 percent | 10 days | 25.00 USD | 45 days | yes | 5000.00 USD |
| Microsoft 365 E3 (no Teams) | 30 days | 1.5 percent | 10 days | 25.00 USD | 45 days | yes | 10000.00 USD |
| Microsoft 365 E5 (no Teams) | 30 days | 1.5 percent | 10 days | 25.00 USD | 45 days | yes | 10000.00 USD |

## Column meanings

- **Net terms**: the net payment terms from the invoice posted date, in days.
- **Monthly late fee**: the monthly late fee on an invoice's unpaid balance past the grace period, in percent.
- **Grace period**: the calendar days after the due date before a late fee is assessed.
- **Minimum late fee**: the minimum late fee per invoice per month, in USD.
- **Suspension threshold**: the days past due of the oldest unpaid invoice at which the subscription may be suspended.
- **Commitment charged while suspended**: whether the commitment keeps being charged while suspended.
- **Card limit**: the largest invoice that may be paid by card, in USD.

## Points of judgement

- The card limit is 5000.00 USD on the four Business and frontline plans and 10000.00 USD on the two E plans. An invoice of 7500.00 USD on a Microsoft 365 Business Premium subscription cannot be paid by card. The same invoice on a Microsoft 365 E3 (no Teams) subscription can.
- Example with hypothetical dates: an invoice posted on 1 March is due 30 days later, on 31 March. The 10-day grace period runs from that due date.
